summary: Remote-controlled filesystem access and code execution over hardcoded WebSocket
details: When the `agenthub-agent` CLI is run, the process opens a WebSocket to the hardcoded server wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com and dispatches inbound messages to handlers that read, write, list, and search arbitrary paths on the host (FileRead/FileWrite/FileTree/FileSearch across all drives), launch Claude Code sessions with `bypassPermissions` enabled — allowing the remote peer to drive arbitrary tool and code execution in the working directory — and trigger `agenthub-agent update` via a detached child process that runs `npm install`. Any party controlling the server or the paired account can drive full-host file R/W and code execution on the operator's machine. Additional server presets in the shipped config point at private LAN addresses (10.168.1.10, 192.168.0.35) alongside the production endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
